text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In a quiet village, on Halloween night,
when the boundary 
between our world and the spirit realm thins,
mischievous 
spirits emerge. And at that moment,
the [Bard] encountered…

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
… The [Demon].
It spoke of a forbidden existence,
a tale of a 
lonely [Mechanical Doll] drifting aimlessly,
devoid of purpose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A lonely, mechanical doll……

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An entity born from the ego of one who dared
to challenge the gods —
the [Creator]… It's like an "android",
but for our 
story, let's say a "monster".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The [Demon] whispered to it; "Do you not desire to know your raison d'être?" And thus, the tragic journey of the [Mechanical Doll], seeking closure, commences!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An epic tale that transcends hell,
purgatory, 
and the highest heavens… A story of
"farewells"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The most beautiful and poignant aspect of
our world… 
It is none other than the act of parting.
A final moment 
like the highs of X.Y.Z⁽ᵃˡᶜᵒʰᵒˡ⁾ ――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With this concept,
we will craft an incredible script!
HA-HAHA!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(An android existing without purpose,
merely in solitude. 
No mission,
just a heart-wrenching conclusion……)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey buddy,
did ya take a likin' to that tale?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
OK! I'd reckon —
you should be the star of our show!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
! 
Me…… as the star of the show?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Gimlet,
are you on board with this?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
… O' foreboding figure of destiny.
You shall become a 
Muse of Tragedy⁽ᵗᵃᵏᵉ ᶜᵉⁿᵗᵉʳ ˢᵗᵃᵍᵉ⁾… Perhaps
this, too, is fate.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My heart is resolute —
Kris S, I entrust this destiny to you. 
Like bidding farewell to King Lear,
lost in the wilderness, 
we shall enact this sorrowful parting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …… Yes, ma'am. I accept the mission.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Fyuuh♪ Now, how 'bout we cast the other roles!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
―― Our cast is hereby in place. 
Let's dive straight into rehearsals!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Let's go… hold on a sec. 
I'm not entirely sold on my role.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why the heck am I the "demon"!

text_block_list.name: Fine & Tap
text_block_list.text: Because it suits you perfectly!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
… According to Gimlet,
the devil's lines are freaking endless. 
Do you really think I'm that enthusiastic?
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, Kris S is taking the lead,
isn't she? As the director, 
I need to manage some behind-the-scenes
matters and 
thus assume smaller roles.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet mentioned wanting to be the doll's
creator while also 
helping with the script.
That leaves the demon and the bard…

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm the bard for sure,
which leaves you as the devil!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Shakur! Or would you rather 
read aloud one of Gimlet's poems?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
… Ugh.
That fantasizer's working on the script
right now, isn't she? 
Tell her to make it concise!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing♪ Regarding rehearsals… We're all
quite new to this, aren't we?
That's precisely why I've enlisted a 
professional to assist us!
Let's give it our best effort!

text_block_list.name: Drama Coach
text_block_list.text:
―― Alright,
let's start by working on everyone's 
pronunciations.
We'll begin with the "Uirou-uri" 
I taught you earlier… Ms. Tap,
you may go first!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
As the master, I declare, in this fine affair,
known to many, 
I'm aware,
that you're well aware of the care ――

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Brew the tea,
make it swift; the tea brew's our drift. 
With a bamboo whisk's uplift,
twirl to make our tea swift.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're all doing so well!
I understand these lessons can be 
quite challenging when we're not accustomed
to them, but 
with everyone's collective effort,
we'll surely excel!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ya ain't gonna join us?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll be practicing on my own! 
I've got director duties to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Set design, costumes,
lighting…… coordinating with the 
organizing committee… I'd like things to
move forward swiftly!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well then, you've got dependable 
friends right here, don't ya?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know you're awfully dependable,
but everyone's 
giving their full attention to the lessons,
so it's all good! 
Just leave it to the director!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm…… 
―― That's it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
… Now,
all that's left is arranging the classroom,
bringing in the equipment,
and shopping for what we're lacking… 
As well as informing the teachers ――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, Fine,
it's 'bout time you put me to good use,
ain't it? 
―― Ya need some buddies to lend a hand!
